murphy_dad.text: Grand to see you. 'Grand' means anything from fine to fantastic, depending on the tone.
Cork Harbour at Cobh is one of the biggest natural harbours in the world. The Titanic made her last stop there in 1912.
Never eat chips outdoors. A Chipgull has no manners, and a Pierlord will take the paper too.

murphy_kid.text: I am learning the tin whistle. Everyone says I am doing great, which is what they say about squeaking.
Dad calls the TV remote 'the yoke'. A yoke is any thing at all. It is the most useful word in Cork.
